name: Stage 13:1: Gnesta to Etapp 13
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 13:1, Gnesta to Etapp 13.
utilities: Official area: Gnesta kommun, Södertäljes kommun.

Gnesta station is the official start and the strong access/service node, with SL commuter rail, Mälartåg/regional trains, buses, town services, and parking around the station area. Check live traffic because rail replacement buses and timetable changes can occur.

Gnesta station parking is verified in several station-area lots, and Sörmlandstrafiken maps bus bays, kiosk, restaurant, taxi, waiting room, and station parking nearby. Local rules vary: Gnesta kommun notes free central parking with P-disc/24 h weekday rules in places, so check signs before leaving a car.
Gnesta has the strongest resupply on the connector, with ICA, Coop, visitor/tourist information, and other town services within a short walk of the station.

Klämmingsbergsbadet is the main mid-route service node, but most services are seasonal. Municipality/Campcation sources place the rental/visitor-service period roughly 1 June-30 September, with full service strongest in summer; the Kattnäs road barrier is reported open 1 May-30 September.

Gnesta municipality plans Klämmingsbergsbadet upgrades from 2026, including toilets, kiosk, parking, showers/changing rooms, washing-up places for campers, and service improvements. Treat facility layout and availability as potentially changing during works.
Frustuna and Kattnäs church areas provide useful toilet/parking context near the route, but these are church/visitor services rather than official Sörmlandsleden trail utilities.
No Sörmlandsleden shelter was verified on 13:1 itself. The nearest confirmed shelter/fireplace/toilet cluster is Djupsjön on the Stage 13 continuation east/northeast of the connector junction.
waterSources: No reliable year-round potable trail tap was confirmed along the connector.

Klämmingsbergsbadet likely has seasonal drinking water while the bathing/camping service is open based on a hiker comment and service-building context, but municipality sources do not explicitly guarantee a public drinking-water tap. Treat it as seasonal/unverified.
Klämmingen and other lakes are bathing/natural water only; filter/boil/treat if used.
The nearby Stage 13 / 13:2 spring north of Djupsjön is continuation/branch context, not core 13:1 water, and can be seasonal or dry; carry enough water from Gnesta or confirmed seasonal services.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Official distance is 13 km; Naturkartan agrees and AllTrails/Äventyrligare are close at about 13.2 km.

Official route changed in June 2025 after Frustuna kyrka, with a new alignment over Jagbacken via the scout hut before the Södertuna road/cycleway section. The official map was updated 2025-06-11; OSM relation 6620044 was later surveyed/edited in November 2025 and appears continuous, but older GPX/app caches and comments can still conflict, so use current official/Naturkartan geometry as canonical.

For route drawing, use the official Gnesta start coordinate 59.048333,17.312467 even if OSM relation 6620044 begins about 80 m away at the station-side node. At the north end, connect 13:1 to Stage 13 at OSM node 2819424933 and keep the adjacent 13:2 join about 9 m away as its own exact junction.

Model this as a station-to-forest access connector: Gnesta services, Frustuna/Jagbacken reroute, about 1 km of road/cycleway near Södertuna, farm/field roads toward Kattnäs, Klämmingsbergsbadet, then forest roads, paths, clearcut/overgrowth stretches, and hillier ground toward the main stage.
The actual connector/main-route join is west/southwest of the Djupsjön service node; do not visually snap the whole branch directly to the shelter if route geometry shows a separate join.

Recent/third-party comments mention long road/cycleway sections, clear-cut feeling sections, tall grass, branches, and the 2025 reroute. Official page reported no active fault reports at the time of research.

User reports generally treat 13:1 as a useful transit connector rather than a showcase stage: easy-to-moderate overall, but with long gravel/asphalt/field-road stretches, summer heat/bugs/ticks, and a hillier forest finish after Klämmingsbergsbadet.
Use only confirmed public fire/grill places such as Klämmingsbergsbadet and Djupsjön; Frustunaby/Jagbacken scout hut is a rentable/group facility, not a public shelter, toilet, tap, or fireplace.
Frustunaby/Scoutgården is a private/group-rental property with its own guest rules; the trail passes outside the entrance, so do not map it as public trail infrastructure.

Gnesta local order rules matter around public places: alcohol is banned at public bathing places, camping is banned at public bathing places except arranged/paid camping, dogs must be leashed in covered public areas and kept off public bathing places 15 May-15 September except assigned dog-bathing areas, and dog waste must be picked up.

Klämmingen fishing requires a valid Gnestaortens FVOF permit, and ordinary rules include hand-gear limitations, pike-perch size/limit rules, and no fishing within 100 m of private jetties or boat places.

Adjacent Stage 13 reserve context matters if continuing beyond the connector: Stora Envättern has dead-spruce/bark-beetle fall risk in wind, fires only at designated sites, no fishing, dogs leashed, no off-road cycling, and max two consecutive tent nights.

facilities.name: Gnesta station
facilities.description: Official start area with SL commuter rail, Mälartåg/regional rail, buses, nearby parking, and town services. Sörmlandstrafiken terminal context includes bus bays, kiosk, restaurant, taxi, and waiting room; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Gnesta bus terminal
facilities.description: Bus interchange beside Gnesta station. Check Sörmlandstrafiken/SL live departures before relying on rural connections.

facilities.name: Gnesta centrum resupply
facilities.description: Town food/resupply near the station, including Hemköp/Gnesta centrum context from official stage data plus ICA and Coop nearby. Useful before starting, not a trail facility.

facilities.name: ICA Supermarket Gnesta
facilities.description: Resupply near the start; opening hours change, so verify before planning a late/early start.

facilities.name: Coop Gnesta
facilities.description: Resupply very near Gnesta station; opening hours change, so verify before relying on it.

facilities.name: Gnesta tourist/service information
facilities.description: Town information/service context for local trail, bath, and visitor details near the start.

facilities.name: Gnesta station parking
facilities.description: Station-area parking context. OSM maps a large free lot nearby; Gnesta kommun notes local P-disc and 24 h weekday rules in central areas, so check signs.

facilities.name: Frustuna kyrka
facilities.description: Church and landmark on the early connector route before the 2025 Jagbacken reroute area. Parish sources list visitor opening and nearby bus access; treat any facilities as church services.

facilities.name: Frustuna kyrka bus stop
facilities.description: Bus-stop pair near Frustuna kyrka; useful side-access context, but departures are timetable-dependent.

facilities.name: Frustuna/Kattnäs churchyard rules
facilities.description: Churchyard/public-place caveat: do not camp or drink alcohol on churchyards/cemeteries; keep dogs controlled and clean up after them.

facilities.name: Frustuna kyrka toilet
facilities.description: Church/cemetery toilet context near the reroute area. A church maintenance-plan source describes an accessible toilet in a separate building about 35 m away; verify locally and do not treat as a guaranteed trail toilet.

facilities.name: Jagbacken/scout hut reroute area
facilities.description: Approximate 2025 reroute area after Frustuna kyrka via Jagbacken/scout hut. Frustunaby/Scoutgården is a rentable private/group facility with beds and campfire context, not a public shelter, toilet, tap, or fireplace; follow the marked trail past the entrance.

facilities.name: Södertuna Slott
facilities.description: Near-route hotel/restaurant context officially listed by Sörmlandsleden. Guest services are opening/booking dependent.

facilities.name: Södertuna bus stop context
facilities.description: Bus-stop context near the road/cycleway section by Södertuna; OSM notes no shelter, and service should be live-checked.

facilities.name: Private farm/field road caveat
facilities.description: Between Södertuna, Kattnäs, and Klämmingsbergsbadet the route uses farm/field roads. Stay on marked trail, avoid yards/tomtmark, do not damage crops, close gates if used, and avoid disturbing residents or livestock.

facilities.name: Kattnäs kyrka
facilities.description: Church/heritage landmark before the badplats road. Seasonal church context with bus 543 nearby, but some departures may require prebooking and no public toilet/tap guarantee was verified.

facilities.name: Kattnäs road barrier
facilities.description: The road barrier by Kattnäs kyrka toward Klämmingsbergsbadet is reported open 1 May-30 September. Outside that period, car access to the bathing area may be blocked.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet
facilities.description: Municipal bathing/camping area with seasonal service building, changing rooms, kiosk, cabins/camping, caravan/camper places, dog-bathing area, grill, and beach access. Road barrier at Kattnäs is reported open 1 May-30 Sep.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet parking
facilities.description: Parking near the bathing/camping area; access and payment/signage should be checked locally, especially outside the May-September road-gate season.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet toilets/showers
facilities.description: Seasonal toilets/showers/service building; strongest confirmed mid-route toilet context, but verify opening period before relying on it.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet seasonal water (verify)
facilities.description: Seasonal/operational drinking water is reported by a hiker comment when the bathing/camping area is open, but municipality sources do not explicitly guarantee a public drinking-water tap. Verify locally.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet grill place
facilities.description: Prepared grill/fireplace at the bathing area, with benches/table and beach context. Grillplatser notes a small shelter, but it is not suitable for overnighting; check fire bans.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet camping/stugor
facilities.description: Seasonal paid camping/cabins/camper area. Gnesta context lists four small cabins and camper/caravan places bookable roughly 1 Jun-30 Sep, with service levels strongest in summer.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet local rules
facilities.description: Local-rule marker: public bathing-place alcohol and camping restrictions apply; dogs must use the assigned dog-bathing area and are otherwise restricted from public bathing places 15 May-15 Sep. Bathing/jetties are at your own risk, children need supervision, and fire is only at prepared places when allowed.

facilities.name: Klämmingsbergsbadet upgrade works
facilities.description: Gnesta plans upgrades from 2026, including toilets, kiosk, parking, showers/changing rooms, washing-up places for campers, and service improvements. Facility locations and availability may change during works.

facilities.name: Klämmingen lake water
facilities.description: Bathing-water monitoring can support swimming quality but does not make this potable trail water; filter/boil/treat if used.

facilities.name: Klämmingen fishing rules
facilities.description: Fishing requires a valid Gnestaortens FVOF permit. Ordinary rules include hand-gear limits, pike-perch size/limit rules, and no fishing within 100 m of private jetties or boat places.

facilities.name: Viewpoint after Klämmingsbergsbadet
facilities.description: Official text says not to miss the viewpoint shortly after the bathing area; OSM viewpoint coordinate.

facilities.name: Ancient hillfort spur
facilities.description: Official text notes a hillfort spur about 1 km after the viewpoint. Approximate marker; confirm exact Fornsök geometry before precision use.

facilities.name: Etapp 13 / 13:2 join near Björnmossen
facilities.description: Exact Stage 13:1 join to the main route from OSM node 2819424933, west/southwest of the Djupsjön service node. Stage 13:2 joins Stage 13 separately about 10 m away; present them as one connector hub but draw exact geometry.

facilities.name: Djupsjön shelter/service node (Stage 13 continuation)
facilities.description: Nearby Stage 13 shelter/fireplace/toilet/trash context east/northeast of the 13:1 endpoint. Useful for route planning, but not mid-stage 13:1 infrastructure.

facilities.name: Djupsjön fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fireplace by the Djupsjön shelter area on main stage 13; check fire bans.

facilities.name: Djupsjön dry toilet (no drinking water)
facilities.description: Dry toilet context near the main-route junction/service area; OSM tags drinking_water=no. Verify exact closest toilet in the field.

facilities.name: 13:2 spring near Djupsjön continuation
facilities.description: Official spring about 800 m north on Stage 13:2. Continuation/branch context only; reliability is unknown and Stage 13 water sources can run dry.
